text:
Marta: Quick FYI — Riley just told me two huge things: promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and got engaged last night 💍. Can we do a small surprise at the office next week? Thinking desk decorations + group card + a gift. Who's in?
Sam: OMG congrats Riley!! :tada: I'm in for decorations and cake. What day works?
Leo: +1 for cake. Also happy to chip in for a gift — how much do we want to aim for? $50-$75?
Jamie: I'll coordinate the card and flowers. Can we do Wed 3/31 after stand? Riley's usually at their desk 10-6.
Sam: Wed works. I'll order a small vanilla cake from Patisserie — any allergies? Riley, pls don't spoil the surprise 😬
Riley: Wait what... why am I getting pings? 😂 Promo and engagement are true, but you can't surprise me — I already told Marta at lunch. But I'm down to celebrate! ❤️
Marta: Oops my bad — I thought it was under wraps. Still celebrating! Can we do lunch in the kitchen at 12:30 then? Cake + quick toast. Also GiftsBot — create a collection.
GiftsBot: Created a collection 'RileyCongrats' with link https://gifts.company/collect/RileyCongrats — goal $300 — 3 contributors so far.
Leo: I'll chip $60. Adding a small desk plant too if nobody objects.
Jamie: Works for me. RSVP: yes. Also who will take pics?
Sam: I'll bring my phone + the good camera. Also I'll put up a tiny banner.
Riley: You absolute sweethearts. Thank you all 💛 Can't wait to see everyone!
